'''Twiggs''', also known as '''Twiggsie''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Kobarian swamp dog]] that lived during the latter years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. After the [[Wroonian/Legends|Wroonian]] heiress [[Pelf Pachoola]] became engaged, her father [[Fume Pachoola]] give Twiggs and the swamp [[Dog/Legends|dog]] [[Higgs]] to his daughter and [[Pelf Pachoola's fiancé|her fiancé]] as a wedding present. Pelf came to adore the pair, and she put them to use as show dogs. Pelf and Fume later embarked on a luxury cruise aboard the [[Luxury liner/Legends|liner]] ''[[Salin Mariner]]'', and the two swamp dogs accompanied them on the voyage. During the trip, the Pachoolas and their two dogs were kidnapped by the [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Hondo Ohnaka/Legends|Hondo Ohnaka]], after he convinced them to accompany him into an [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pod]]. However, the venture proved to be a financial disaster for Ohnaka, and during their captivity the dogs consumed 10 kilos of food a day, yet he was unable to secure a ransom for the Pachoolas' freedom to cover the cost of feeding their pets. Twiggs, Higgs and their owners eventually regained their freedom after Ohnaka and [[Ohnaka Gang/Legends|his gang]] forced a passing delivery [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] to take the captives off their hands.
